title: AnalysisRequest
description: POST /api/v1/analysis request body. Raw user input before Planner interpretation. §6, §7. RECONSTRUCTED from the architecture doc — diff against the actual locked AnalysisRequest.json before use. NOTE: time_range here is the raw user-supplied range, pre-interpretation — do not confuse with shared/TimeWindow.json, which is the Planner's interpreted local+UTC output.

query.description: Natural-language query, typed or transcribed from voice. §6

place_name.description: §7.3. Max length enforced by config, not by this schema.

date.description: ISO 8601 date. Natural-language dates inside query text ('tomorrow') are NOT put here — the Planner interprets those. §7.4, §14

activity.description: Validated against shared-config/activities.json, not a closed schema enum — activities are config-extensible. §7.6

conversation_id.description: Links this analysis to an existing chat conversation. §8

parent_analysis_id.description: The earlier analysis this follow-up or scenario was derived from. §8, §84

place_or_coordinate.description: §7.9 — required together (both present or both absent) for route requests. Reused by RouteRequest.json and AlertSubscriptionRequest.json via fragment $ref.
